config.name: Claudin 18.2 (example)
config.context: Example profile. Reader is a biotech business-development analyst following the Claudin 18.2 field: antibodies, bispecifics, antibody-drug conjugates and cell therapies targeting Claudin 18.2 in gastric, gastroesophageal junction and pancreatic cancer; their trials, data readouts, deals and company moves; and Claudin 18.2 as a biomarker (IHC testing, expression cutoffs, companion diagnostics).
